literal: A king without laziness will attain all that was spanned by the one who measured with his feet, entirely.
translation: A ruler free from laziness will attain all the realms spanned by the one who measured the universe with his feet, all at once.
modern: சோம்பல் இல்லாத அரசன், தன் அடியால் உலகத்தை அளந்தவன் கடந்த நிலப்பரப்பு முழுவதையும் ஒன்றாக அடைவான்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the power of overcoming laziness by comparing the rewards of an active ruler to the entire universe. The poet uses the imagery of the cosmic giant who measured the universe with his feet to represent the vastness of the earth. A king who is completely free from sloth will easily conquer and rule over all these vast territories together. The contrast highlights how diligence can overcome any boundary and bring supreme success.
